text: This might be a silly one, sorry. I'm looking after my nephew tonight, he's 7. His temperature is 38.2 and one of his eyes has gone pink and sticky, gunky in the corner. He was sick once around tea time but he's kept all his drinks down since then. Breathing's fine, completely normal.
